extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism ontology from paper-local XML/PDF and figure/table locators; claims are limited to directly assayed membrane-model and DNA-interaction evidence.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: ΔM2 perturbs an anionic bacterial-membrane model composed of DMPC/DMPG, with DSC evidence showing loss of the pre-transition and reduced transition enthalpy at a 1:10 peptide-lipid ratio.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Model-membrane biophysics supports membrane interaction but not direct live-cell pore formation or a single exclusive killing mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: ΔM2 interacts with bacterial genomic DNA in UV-visible titration and gel-electrophoresis assays, supporting DNA interaction as a potential intracellular target after membrane access.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: ΔM2 peptide with P. aeruginosa ATCC 27853 gDNA and K. pneumoniae ATCC 2146 gDNA
mechanism_claims.limitations: DNA interaction is source-supported as a potential target; the paper does not prove DNA binding is the only lethal mechanism in whole bacteria.
